summary: Sigma Lithium filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release on UN-Climate Week appearances and operations status, not a special situation. The release describes CEO Ana Cabral's keynote and Nasdaq bell-ringing marking five years listed and a 5x market-cap gain, plus claims of 19,000 Brazilian jobs and "Quintuple Zero" production. It denies media reports that environmental licenses are suspended, asserting mining concessions are unaffected and that FEAM's administrative act lacks validity while Federal Courts review its appeal. No transaction, price, premium, stake, advisor, board recommendation, or deal terms are stated; the filing is an ordinary current report on operational and legal matters.
